risk_note: RV2 payout (withdraw lane B2-06c; model Claude Fable 5.1). The EXECUTE command executeBatch(trx, {appId, members, executorId, now}) on the caller's transaction: ① payout.enabled / payout.queue_paused refuse the whole batch; locks in the module's fixed order (ledger.lockBalances of the members' owners → withdrawals FOR UPDATE; no users row lock, EXECUTE changes no balance); ② per withdrawal under the row lock: still APPROVED through transitionWithdrawal(…, 'EXECUTE'), no BR-WDR-05 block (risk state with expiry judged on the caller's instant, appealing over its previous state, an effective withdraw hold, available_fen < 0 read under the balance lock, blocked_reason set), no kind=transfer attempt of any result, snapshot channel enabled and not paused; ③ the watermark per (app, channel) under pg_advisory_xact_lock in sorted channel order (W = the latest payout_watermarks row, P = round_half_up(7-day amount_fen total of that channel / 7) × 3 over the 7 complete +08:00 days through @couli/domain's calendar, Σ batch + Σ PAYING + Σ paid after t_W compared exactly as Σ × 10000 > W × bp): a single-channel executable set refuses the whole batch, a mixed-channel set only keeps the failing channel's withdrawals (D10-285 / D10-288 Q2 Q3 / D10-290). Then one payout_batches row (manual with created_by = the admin, auto with created_by null for system:auto_payout), moves of ②-left APPROVED members off their old batch by CAS (moved_out item), the CAS APPROVED → PAYING with execute_seq + 1 / executor_id / batch_id / executed_at / row_version + 1, items paying / skipped / blocked, JobQueue.send('payout', 'transfer', {withdrawal_id, execute_seq, app_id}, {trx, singletonKey: id:seq}) and wallet.withdrawal_changed on the same transaction. Amounts are bigint fen through @couli/money; times only from the caller's instant. payout_attempts is read through the module's own store (couli_app SELECT only), which also replaces the worker's placeholder attempts port of B2-05e. Handover (orchestrator 2026-10-26 20:3x): original author withdraw lane (account 4, paused to 10-30; head abc4ee68 stacked on B2-06a / B2-06b); taken over by admin-backend, which took the task's own commits unchanged onto main after B2-06a #1387 (B2-06b already merged as #1462), resolved additive conflicts only, and re-ran the red run and the full verification on the test machine. Reviews were not re-run: the task's code and tests are the reviewed ones.
